# lineage-openclaw-archive-subprojects

Archived OpenClaw subprojects. Search-only; do not lift code.

## Stack & contents

TypeScript subprojects from `/home/trajan/archive/openclaw`. ~1,114 files. Includes a substantial gateway-backend with paired `.test.ts` files (auth, channel-health, boot, call) and helper bin scripts.

## Why this is here

Where to look for **how OpenClaw actually authenticated and routed** before EMA absorbed the doctrine. Useful when designing per-driver auth in the harness layer.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/lineage-openclaw-archive-subprojects:code/control-ui/openclaw-control-ui-source/ARCHITECTURE.md
git show origin/lineage-openclaw-archive-subprojects:code/control-ui/openclaw-control-ui-source/gateway-backend/auth.ts
```
